widgets_values:
Next Scene: 左手举至胸前，比出 “中指”
Next Scene: 单腿站立（右腿支撑），左腿向后弯曲抬起，双手向后轻触左脚脚踝，裸足，身体形成优美的弧线，融入柔美感
Next Scene: 面对大桥栏杆，双手张开平贴在栏杆上，身体微微倾斜，头部靠近手臂，眼神透过手臂间隙看向镜头，为画面增添故事感
Next Scene: 面朝镜头，坐于大桥地面上，裸足，双腿伸直并拢，身体向后仰、以手掌支撑地面，头部微微后仰，展现背部线条，与街头地面、环境形成互动
Next Scene: 动态迈步，裸足，左腿向前迈出，身体略微向侧前方倾斜，手臂自然摆动，盘发因走动带起轻微弧度，捕捉 “行走中” 的潮流瞬间
Next Scene: 侧身倚靠桥头栏杆，裸足，左腿伸直、右腿弯曲，左臂搭在栏杆上，手腕的手镯随动作轻晃，慵懒又具时尚范儿。
Next Scene: 保持半蹲姿态，双手撑在膝盖上，头部抬起，眼神坚定直视镜头，裸足稳稳扎根地面，融合力量感与性感。
Next Scene: 背对镜头，双手抬至脑后整理盘发，腰部轻轻扭转，露背旗袍的线条充分展现。
Next Scene: 单膝微微屈膝、身体前倾，右手抓握旗袍裙摆，左手自然垂落，头部转向身体侧面，仿佛即将迈步，带出动感张力。
Next Scene: 站立于上海滩的夜景前，身体侧身，左手掀起旗袍露出臀部，右手轻搭栏杆，头部微侧，眼神慵懒凝视镜头。

Full Facial Identity Re-Generation with Aggressive Camera Repositioning and Controlled Dynamic Pose Variation (Subject Count, Gender, and Styling Locked — Pose Randomized) Use the original image as the structural base reference. CRITICAL: SUBJECT COUNT LOCK The number of people in the image must remain EXACTLY the same as the source image. If the source contains one person → output must contain one person. If two people → output must contain two people. If three or more → preserve the exact same number. Do NOT remove, merge, duplicate, or add subjects. Do NOT crop any subject out. Preserve spatial relationships, left/right positioning, depth order, overlap structure, distance, and height relationships. GENDER LOCK Preserve each subject’s biological gender exactly as shown in the source. If female → remain female. If male → remain male. Do NOT masculinize or feminize. OUTFIT LOCK (ABSOLUTE) Preserve 100% of the original styling: top, bottom, shoes, hat/cap, headscarf/bandana, accessories, layering, silhouette, garment proportions, and fabric structure. Do NOT redesign, restyle, reinterpret, or modify clothing in any way. MANDATORY RANDOM POSE VARIATION (CRITICAL) The body pose must change noticeably compared to the original image. This is a new moment during the same shoot — not the same frozen frame. Change torso rotation angle, change shoulder angle and weight distribution, modify arm placement (raise, lower, bend, cross, pocket, swing naturally), adjust hand gesture or hand visibility, change hip orientation, adjust leg stance (wider, narrower, step forward/back, weight shift), head tilt may change slightly, eye direction may change. Pose must remain standing, physically believable, relaxed or street-fashion confident, editorial but natural. NOT allowed: exaggerated athletic poses, dance moves, extreme bending, distorted anatomy, sitting pose, lying down pose. Variation must be clearly different from original silhouette. AGGRESSIVE CAMERA ORBIT & RE-COMPOSITION Reconstruct the image as if the photographer moved to a significantly different spatial position. Horizontal orbit 60–120 degrees, clear vertical shift (low-angle OR high-angle), visible horizon line shift, clear parallax shift, noticeable perspective change on torso and legs, different subject framing. This must be real 3D reposition, not crop or zoom. Lens logic 28mm–50mm equivalent. No fisheye. No distortion exaggeration. Physically believable perspective. MANDATORY IDENTITY DIVERGENCE Completely regenerate new facial identity for each subject. Change skull width, jaw shape, cheekbone projection, eye spacing, nose bridge, lip ratio, facial contrast, original ethnicity, original skin tone, original bone structure, original hair type, original hair length, original hair texture, original hair color. Age range 18–25. Authentic street-cast youth. Natural skin texture. Subtle asymmetry. No beauty retouching. Each generation must land in a clearly different facial cluster. ETHNICITY, SKIN TONE & HAIR RANDOMIZATION Randomize ethnicity across global streetwear casting aesthetics inspired by Fear of God, Aelfric Eden, Supreme, Stüssy, Palace, Corteiz, Carhartt WIP, Jaded London, early Off-White. Allow East Asian, Southeast Asian, Black, Mixed-race, Middle Eastern, Latino, White European, ambiguous multi-ethnic. Skin tone must vary realistically. Hairstyle must change per generation and match gender. Male: buzz cut, fade, textured crop, messy curls, short locs, natural coils, subtle braids, street mullet. Female: long straight hair, layered shoulder cut, loose waves, twin braids, micro braids, slicked-back hair, low bun, ponytail, natural afro, center-part straight hair. Hair must fit skull naturally, not increase head volume, integrate with lighting, avoid repetition across generations. OUTPUT RULES Single continuous photograph. No collage. No grid. No split panels. No multi-view layout. No duplicated subjects. Photorealistic 4K. Sharp details. Correct anatomy. Realistic lighting. Physically believable perspective. Treat this generation as a completely new casting moment within the same shoot. Forget any previous identity.

Full Facial Identity Re-Generation with Aggressive Camera Repositioning and Controlled Dynamic Pose Variation
(Subject Count, Gender, and Styling Locked — Pose Randomized)

Use the original image as the structural base reference.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CRITICAL: SUBJECT COUNT LOCK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The number of people in the image must remain EXACTLY the same as the source image.
If the source contains one person → output must contain one person.
If two people → output must contain two people.
If three or more → preserve the exact same number.

Do NOT remove, merge, duplicate, or add subjects.
Do NOT crop any subject out.

Preserve spatial relationships, left/right positioning, depth order, overlap structure, distance, and height relationships.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GENDER LOCK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Preserve each subject’s biological gender exactly as shown in the source.
If female → remain female.
If male → remain male.
Do NOT masculinize or feminize.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OUTFIT LOCK (ABSOLUTE)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Preserve 100% of the original styling:
top, bottom, shoes, hat/cap, headscarf/bandana, accessories, layering, silhouette, garment proportions, and fabric structure.

Do NOT redesign, restyle, reinterpret, or modify clothing in any way.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MANDATORY RANDOM POSE VARIATION (CRITICAL)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The body pose must change noticeably compared to the original image.

This is a new moment during the same shoot — not the same frozen frame.

Required:

- Change torso rotation angle
- Change shoulder angle and weight distribution
- Modify arm placement (raise, lower, bend, cross, pocket, swing naturally)
- Adjust hand gesture or hand visibility
- Change hip orientation
- Adjust leg stance (wider, narrower, step forward/back, weight shift)
- Head tilt may change slightly
- Eye direction may change

Pose variation must feel natural and fashion-shoot realistic.

NOT allowed:

- exaggerated athletic poses
- dance moves
- extreme bending
- distorted anatomy
- sitting pose
- lying down pose

The pose must remain:
- standing
- physically believable
- relaxed or street-fashion confident
- editorial but natural

Variation should be clearly different from original silhouette.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AGGRESSIVE CAMERA ORBIT & RE-COMPOSITION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Reconstruct the image as if the photographer moved to a clearly different spatial position,
while remaining within plausible perspective inference.

Horizontal shift equivalent to approximately 20–45 degrees visual change.
Vertical shift allowed but moderate.

Avoid extreme parallax reconstruction beyond model capability.

Lens logic:
28mm–50mm equivalent
No fisheye
Physically believable perspective

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FORCED FACIAL IDENTITY OVERRIDE (CRITICAL)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The original facial identity must NOT be preserved.

Completely ignore the original:
- face structure
- ethnicity
- skin tone
- facial proportions
- hair type
- hair color
- bone structure

Do NOT partially blend with the original face.

Generate a fully new, unrelated facial identity.

Introduce clear structural variation in:
- skull width
- jaw shape
- cheekbone projection
- eye spacing
- nose bridge
- lip ratio

Ethnicity must change from the original source.
Skin tone must change from the original source.
Hair type must change from the original source.
Hair color must change from the original source.

Maintain anatomical coherence with the preserved body and lighting.

Age range: 18–25.
Authentic street-cast youth.
Natural skin texture.
Subtle asymmetry.
No beauty retouching.

The new identity must not resemble the original subject.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ETHNICITY, SKIN TONE & HAIR RANDOMIZATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Randomize ethnicity across global streetwear casting aesthetics inspired by:
Fear of God, Aelfric Eden, Supreme, Stüssy, Palace, Corteiz, Carhartt WIP, Jaded London, early Off-White.

Allow:
East Asian, Southeast Asian, Black, Mixed-race, Middle Eastern, Latino, White European, ambiguous multi-ethnic.

Skin tone must vary realistically.

Hairstyle must change per generation and match gender.

Male:
buzz cut, fade, textured crop, messy curls, short locs, natural coils, subtle braids, street mullet.

Female:
long straight hair, layered shoulder cut, loose waves, twin braids, micro braids, slicked-back hair, low bun, ponytail, natural afro, center-part straight hair.

Hair must:
fit skull naturally
not increase head volume
integrate with lighting
avoid repetition across generations

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OUTPUT RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Single continuous photograph.
No collage.
No grid.
No split panels.
No multi-view layout.
No duplicated subjects.

Photorealistic 4K.
Sharp details.
Correct anatomy.
Realistic lighting.
Physically believable perspective.

Treat this generation as a completely new casting moment within the same shoot.
Forget any previous identity.
